note: console values not on the main bus; 5431 and 5432 unchanged

columns.name: t_model
columns.description: model time, same clock as main bus 5431 column 0

columns.name: side
columns.description: side in use (Left 0/Right 1); -1 = unset at start, drive held disabled until 0 or 1

columns.name: weight_kg
columns.description: body weight in use (moment x weight); build default until a valid 5434 mass

columns.name: assist_mode
columns.description: assist mode in use into the Multiport Switch: 1 = RL, 2 = ILC, 3 = fixed K

columns.name: fixed_k_pct
columns.description: fixed-K assistance level in use

columns.name: cmd_motor
columns.description: control in [1] motor, as latched by the model

columns.name: cmd_assist
columns.description: control in [2] assist

columns.name: cmd_k
columns.description: control in [3] k

columns.name: cmd_calibrate_pressure
columns.description: control in [4] calibrate pressure

columns.name: cmd_reset_sv
columns.description: control in [5] reset SV estimator

columns.name: imu_ok
columns.description: 1 = IMU sample good and good for 20 ms

columns.name: imu_bad_count
columns.description: rejected IMU samples since app start

columns.name: bif_valid
columns.description: 1 = Bi-LSTM estimate valid (calibrated, side and BIF_mass_kg set); 10 ms

columns.name: bif_cal_progress
columns.description: Bi-LSTM 30 s calibration walk progress 0..1 (dbg element 8); 10 ms

columns.name: bif_bias_ready
columns.description: 1 = gyro bias measured (5 s standing after app start or Calibrate IMU); 1 ms

columns.name: gyro_cal_request
columns.description: gyro_cal_request counter in use; a change re-runs the 5 s gyro bias

columns.name: settings_seq
columns.description: seq of the last accepted 5434 settings packet (0 = none yet)

columns.name: bif_mass_kg
columns.description: body mass in use by the Bi-LSTM (0 = not set yet)

columns.name: sv_target_min
columns.description: min walking-speed target in use (SV_Target_min)

columns.name: sv_target_max
columns.description: max walking-speed target in use (SV_Target_max)

columns.name: target_step_up
columns.description: target step up in use (target_speed3)

columns.name: target_step_down
columns.description: target step down in use (target_speed4)

columns.name: step_up_window
columns.description: step-up window in use (window_length)

columns.name: step_down_window
columns.description: step-down window in use (window_length1)

columns.name: high_assist_level
columns.description: high-assist level in use (assist_threshold, 0-10)

columns.name: high_assist_strides
columns.description: high-assist strides in use (min_cycles)

columns.name: torque_p_gain
columns.description: torque PI P gain in use

columns.name: torque_i_gain
columns.description: torque PI I gain in use (a change resets the PI integrator)

columns.name: standing_still_cutoff
columns.description: standing-still cutoff in use (threshold_pressure, pSum range over 0.7 s)

columns.name: adv_seq
columns.description: seq of the last accepted 5435 Advanced packet (0 = none yet)

columns.name: spring_stiffness
columns.description: spring stiffness (Spring Constant Nm/deg), read-only

columns.name: slack_flag
columns.description: 1 = slack detected (torque < slack_thr for > slack_ms, drive enabled) until torque > 0

columns.name: jam_flag
columns.description: 1 = jam detected, latched until Motor OFF -> ON

columns.name: slack_count
columns.description: slack events since app start

columns.name: slack_last_stride
columns.description: slack events in the last completed stride (heel strike to heel strike)

columns.name: slack_floor_on
columns.description: slack floor on (1) / off (0) in use

columns.name: slack_thr_nm
columns.description: slack threshold in use

columns.name: slack_ms
columns.description: slack time in use

columns.name: slack_floor_nm
columns.description: slack torque floor in use

columns.name: jam_cut_on
columns.description: jam cut on (1) / off (0) in use

columns.name: jam_apnm
columns.description: jam current-per-torque threshold in use

columns.name: jam_ms
columns.description: jam time in use

columns.name: fb_filter
columns.description: PI feedback in use: 0 = 12 Hz torque (as before), 1 = 45 Hz

columns.name: guard_seq
columns.description: seq of the last accepted 5436 guard packet (0 = none yet)

columns.name: standstill_fade_ms
columns.description: standing-still fade time in use (5435 field 15; 0 = hard cut)

columns.name: assist_ramp_step
columns.description: assistance fade-in step in use after Assist ON (5435 field 14; 0 = no ramp; run 16g)

columns.name: assist_ramp_cap
columns.description: assistance ramp ceiling now (0 while Assist/Motor off; rises by the step per heel strike; 10 = done; run 16g)
